help.immersive_brewing.alembic.cool: Coolant valve %s / %s: too little lets vapour escape, too much chokes the coil.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.goal: Route the condensate: cloudy heads to waste, the clear heart to the receiver, the hazy tail back to waste.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.heat: Heat valve %s / %s: enough heat to run steadily, not so much that it rushes.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.receiver: Switch the receiver with %s or the receiver button. The marks are a guide; watch the condensate itself.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.score: Collection counts 50%%, heat 30%%, cooling 20%%. A score of 35 or more raises quality, never above the cap.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.add: When the tray says Add now, press %s to tip in the shown ingredient. Early or late additions cost a little; a missed one is added for you at the end of its phase.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.goal: Tend the brew through Bloom, Infuse and Settle. Keep the heat marker in the shaded heat band and the circulation where the brew asks for it.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.heat: %s raises the burner's draft and %s lowers it: more draft, more heat. Heat has inertia: change the draft before the liquid gets there.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.score: Heat counts 40%%, circulation 35%%, additions 25%%. A score of %s brews exactly the normal potion; better work lasts longer and drinks faster.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.signature: Each reaction shows its own surface: foam, sediment, shimmer, streaks, bubbles, whorls, glints or motes. The written cues say what each needs.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.stir: Hold %s or %s to stir; add %s for a vigorous stir. Release to let the liquid coast. Circles drawn over the liquid also stir.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.finish: Press %s or Done when the texture is right. The timer only resolves what is there; it never wastes the ingredient.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.fold: When the batch clumps, lift and fold with %s or a right click.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.goal: Break the ingredient down to the even texture shown, then stop. Overworking turns it to dust or splits an emulsion.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.move: Steer the pestle with the mouse in the bowl, or %s %s %s %s.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.press: Hold the left mouse button or %s to press. Firm pressure cracks coarse pieces; finish with a lighter touch.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.score: Extraction is 70%% reaching the endpoint and 30%% restraint: avoiding too much pressure and needless work.
help.immersive_brewing.seal: Escape or Seal stores the batch exactly as it is. Resume it later from the station; nothing is lost and nothing rerolls.

jei.immersive_brewing.info.alembic: Purification: three identical, unrefined potions become two of better quality, once per batch and never above the cap. Fill the coolant jacket with water, pour the charge, close the clamp, open the burner and coolant valves, and move the diverter to the receiver while the stream runs clear (cloudy and hazy condensate belong in the waste). Reclamation: three unwanted potions become Spent Alchemical Salt and their bottles. The bucket in its recipe is part of the apparatus and is consumed.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.carrier: Carries up to six potion stacks exactly as they are. Use it on a Kettle to collect finished bottles or to load an empty rack. It has no effect of its own and can not hold other containers.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.kettle: Brews one to six bottles of one kind as one batch, by hand at the kettle. Load water bottles in the rack, reagents on the tray, blaze powder in the burner and a paddle on its rest; choose a route in the route book. Then tip the bottles in, turn the burner up until small bubbles rise, tip each dose in when the liquid is ready, stir while there is something to carry through, let the surface calm and open the spout over each bottle. One reagent covers up to three bottles; one blaze powder gives 20 fuel charges. Quality from your work changes effect duration and drinking time within bounds; 50 is exactly the normal potion.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.mortar: Prepares one to four units of an effect reagent together, by hand: place them in the bowl, take up the pestle, press and grind until the texture is even, fold with the scraper where it is uneven, then scrape it into the dose cup. Each unit becomes one kit carrying the extraction you earned; raw reagents count as 50. Stop when the texture is right: grinding on only makes fines.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.notebook: The built-in guide: stations, controls, quality, recovery, every supported recipe, favourites, your batch journal and free practice at any idle station. Choosing a route stages its supplies; the work itself happens at the apparatus. Hold a brewed potion in the other hand to label it.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.paddle: Stirs the Kettle by hand: take it up from its rest and move it through the liquid. Each finished batch wears it by one. An iron paddle lasts longer but adds no quality. Accepts Unbreaking and Mending.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.recovery: Dropped when a station breaks during a batch: it holds everything the batch owned, with its exact progress. Install it at an idle station of the same kind and reopen the lid to carry on; it can not be opened by hand.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.1: Every control has a key you can rebind under Controls, and the screens always show the current binding.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.2: At each station, point at a part (or press Tab) and click it (or press Enter): take up the paddle, pestle or scraper and move it over the work, scroll a burner or valve, lift a dose and tip it in, open the spout. Right click or X puts a tool down.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.3: Escape leaves the working view; the batch keeps going while you stay near. L or the lid seals it exactly where it is. Holds can become toggles, nothing needs two keys at once, and the server may allow a wider heat band.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.4: The first time, the view points at the tool to take up, the burner and the first dose. The words at the top always say what the work needs; numeric readings and narration are in the options.
notebook.immersive_brewing.favorites.int: Favourite plans appear first in the Kettle's plan list. Star a plan there to add it.
notebook.immersive_brewing.mode.coexist: This server keeps the ordinary brewing stand working beside the Kettle.
notebook.immersive_brewing.mode.disabled: Brewing jobs are disabled on this server; existing batches can still be resumed or recovered.
notebook.immersive_brewing.mode.replace_: On this server the brewing stand refuses transformations the Kettle covers; use the Kettle for those.
notebook.immersive_brewing.practice.1: Practice works the real apparatus with the same tools, heat and timing, but nothing is used, made or rewarded. Choose a station below, then use an idle one of that kind (or press P in any idle station’s working view).
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.1: Quality is 25%% extraction (preparation) and 75%% brewing control. Crude 0-34, Standard 35-69, Fine 70-89, Masterwork 90-100.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.2: A score of 50 brews exactly the normal potion. Each point above or below changes effect duration by 0.4%%: from 0.8× at 0 to 1.2× at 100. Drinking takes 36 ticks at 0, 32 at 50 and 28 at 100.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.3: Quality never changes an amplifier, never turns a potion into its extended or strong form and never adds bottles. Instant healing and harming keep their exact strength.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.4: Adding redstone, glowstone or a container to a finished potion can never raise its quality. Only the Alembic can, once, and never to Masterwork.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.title: Quality
notebook.immersive_brewing.reagents.hint: Short controlled presses; holding force too long makes fines.
Crack the coarse crystals with firm presses, then lighten up before it turns to dust.
Gentle circular pressure; fold often to expose unworked fibres.
Fold and emulsify; pressing harder does little.
Low, even pressure: uniform mashing beats speed.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recipes.intro: Costs shown for %s servings. Every listed step is checked against the real brewing rules when the world loads.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recipes.stand: Every vanilla path here also works in an ordinary brewing stand unless the server uses replacement mode. Paths added by other mods may need an adapter.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recovery.1: A running batch seals itself when nobody stays near it, and the lid seals it at any time. Nothing is lost and nothing rerolls; reopen the lid to carry on.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recovery.2: Breaking a station with a job inside drops one Recovery Batch with everything the job held. Install it at an idle station of the same kind to continue.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recovery.3: If a mod or datapack the batch needs disappears, the batch is held for recovery instead of being deleted, and comes back when the data does.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.1: Brewing by hand needs three things: a Brewer's Kettle, a brewing paddle and blaze powder for its burner.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.2: Right-click the Kettle with up to six bottles of one kind, the reagents, blaze powder and the paddle to put each in its place, then open the route book. It shows every step, the exact cost and what is missing.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.3: A batch of up to three bottles costs one reagent per step, like a brewing stand. Six bottles cost two. One batch always serves every bottle.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.4: Prepare effect reagents in an Apothecary's Mortar first for better extraction, or use them raw. Practise at any idle station for free from this notebook.

notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.1: Apothecary's Mortar: prepares one to four kits of an effect reagent at once, by hand. A kit replaces one reagent in a brew and carries the extraction you earned.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.2: Brewer's Kettle: brews one to six servings as one batch. The bottles are tipped in and filled again from the spout; it never consumes extra bottles.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.3: Alembic: purifies three identical, unrefined potions into two better ones, once per batch, or reclaims unwanted potions into Spent Alchemical Salt and their bottles.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.4: Hoppers may fill trays and fuel and take finished bottles. They can never take what a job has reserved.

notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.5: Raw reagents can still make a Fine brew: perfect control with default raw extraction reaches quality 88. Preparation is the route past that raw ceiling toward Masterwork, not an entry fee for ordinary brewing.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.6: For instant, harmful, mixed, or custom effects, quality changes only what the server's effect policy supports. A Fine grade does not imply stronger instant healing, a higher amplifier, or safer harmful effects.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.5: At the defaults, the Alembic trades three matching doses for two doses capped at quality 70. That concentrates each remaining dose but reduces total stock; it is not a free efficiency upgrade.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.6: Purification gets one lineage attempt. An attempt that fails to improve quality still uses that allowance; reclamation is the comfortable alternative for surplus potions.

notebook.immersive_brewing.compatibility: This report is supplied by the current server. Each recipe is checked separately; recording quality metadata is not the same as safely scaling its effects.
Tipped-arrow recipes conflict in this pack. The server keeps the live recipe winner; inspect the recipe viewer before committing ingredients.
Some modded transformations are contextual: they can be checked from the Kettle's currently open tray, but cannot be fully listed in advance.
Destination search is work-bounded. Reaching the search limit can omit alternatives; it does not turn an omitted path into an unsupported recipe.
This server reported no infusion recipes.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.7: Apothecary Racks store six exact potion stacks. Set a shelf label or reservation, then use Pack to exchange matching stacks with a Batch Carrier without changing potion data.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.8: A Batch Carrier keeps six exact stacks and a named loadout. Choose a slot in its screen; the carrier equip key moves that selected potion to a safe hotbar slot.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.9: Quick finishing appears only for eligible container-only plans when the server allows it. Choose Finish in the route book, tip the modifier into the finishing fitting and close it; it preserves potion quality and lineage.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.10: Station legend — Idle: no batch is staged. Ready: inputs are present and a valid action can begin.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.11: Running: a batch is active. Sealed: a paused batch is safely saved and can be resumed.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.12: Held: the saved batch needs the shown recovery action. Output blocked: clear the destination, then reopen or collect; the station keeps ownership meanwhile.

cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.charge: Tip the bottles into the kettle.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.warm: Turn the burner up: warm until small bubbles rise.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.dose: The liquid is warm. Lift the next dose and tip it in.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.too_cold: The brew has gone cold and stopped reacting. Warm it a little.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.too_hot: It is boiling hard. Ease the burner.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.dissolve: Pieces are still floating. Carry them through the liquid with the paddle.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.warmer: It is reacting slowly. A little more heat helps.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.reacting: The brew is changing. Let it work.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.ease_heat: The reaction is done. Shut the burner so the surface can calm.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.stop_stirri: Rest the paddle and let it settle.
cue.immersive_brewing.kettle.ready: Ready. Open the spout over a bottle.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.generic: The surface is churning. Slow down.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.light_foam: Froth is rising. Slow the paddle and ease the heat; let the head settle.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.dense_sedi: Heavy material is settling. Sweep the bottom of the liquid broadly.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.delicate_s: The shimmer is breaking. Gentler heat, slower mixing.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.magma_stre: Thick warm ribbons resist. Warm it enough, then fold until uniform.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.suspended_: Bubbles are trapped. Ease the heat and move gently.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.dark_whorl: Dark ribbons persist. Keep mixing until they disperse.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.aligning_g: Bright flecks are scattering. Dissolve the grains, then stop agitating.
cue.immersive_brewing.trouble.floating_m: Motes ride the surface. Draw them in with broad, gentle strokes.
cue.immersive_brewing.finishing.dose: Tip the modifier into the finishing fitting.
cue.immersive_brewing.finishing.settling: The bottles are taking their new form.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.clamp: Close the clamp to seal the still.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.coolant: Open the coolant valve so the condenser can work.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.divert_was: The stream is not clear: send it to the waste collector.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.cloudy: Cloudy heads are running to waste.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.clearing: The stream is clearing. Get ready to collect.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.divert_rec: The stream is clear: send it to the receiver.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.haze: Haze is returning. Get ready to send it to waste.
cue.immersive_brewing.alembic.hazy: Hazy tails are running to waste.
cue.immersive_brewing.sealed: Sealed: nothing changes until it is reopened.
cue.immersive_brewing.held: Held: something it needs is missing (see the station status).
cue.immersive_brewing.legacy: A batch from an earlier version: finish it from the route book stand.

tip.immersive_brewing.workshop.kettle.cl: The heat stayed steady and dark whorls never got out of hand.
tip.immersive_brewing.workshop.kettle.tr: Dark ribbons lingered: keep mixing until they disperse.
tip.immersive_brewing.workshop.kettle.cl: The heat stayed steady and aligning glints never got out of hand.
